text:
- **Command-line code restructured:** The command-line code is now split by noun. The leftover code from the Python port is removed. Every function is under the complexity limit.
- **Agent guidance and checks:** AGENTS.md is now a short map under the size cap. Three agent runtimes read it in full. An agent grades it against a rubric on every pull request. CI authenticates with workload identity federation. No API key is stored.
- **Sprint close rules:** A sprint close now checks only the coverage patterns it added or changed. An older pending pattern from another session no longer blocks it. `pm check` states this close rule in its waiting line and help text.
- **CI run time:** Each pull request now starts fewer macOS jobs. A docs-only pull request skips the Go test matrix. The median run time is still above the target. Go test work on macOS is lower after the item model split and a cheaper test seed.
